items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I met this one girl... Her name was Claire Fisher... she used to come and take me, and she took me around to different places

ctx.x:
The guys were King Guyon(?) and a bass player named Bob Straw. And I don't know what happened to either one of them. I really don't. I know that Bob Straw married the waitress, and King Guyon(?) is supposed to have married some wealthy woman and moved back east here somewhere. I don't know. And I have never seen either one of them since.
Then this drummer started coming in, and he got me with bands he was playing with. He was playing with Mugsy Marcellino and Garwood Vann, and he got me in there -- and I started…
